judgement.reason: LobeHub is a single Next.js web app on PostgreSQL, Redis and S3, so the outcome with changes is reasonable.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unconfirmed service: the repository declares redis (redis:7-alpine) in docker-compose/deploy/docker-compose.yml. Deployz did not find how the application uses it.
reviews.reason: The declared service is Redis, which the app reaches through REDIS_URL and which Deployz provides as managed single-node Redis.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume fts-search-reindex-state:/app/.elasticsearch-reindex (docker-compose/deploy/docker-compose.yml lobe)
reviews.reason: The shown lines do not prove that the Elasticsearch reindex state directory is only a cache or that a supported datastore replaces it.
